resolved_findings.resolution: Revision6 marks Q/P/B/D/E/C/S effect-capable before forwarding. This includes Bind planning, Parse analysis, Describe revalidation, Close cleanup and Sync completion without assuming pre-Execute routines are effect-free. Subsequent new Q/P remains blocked until the matching validated Ready barrier.

positive_assessments: Q and Sync enqueue the current cycle then advance it; matching Ready removes only completed/older effects, preserving newer pipeline effects.
The initial startup Ready is explicitly distinguished; unsolicited or malformed later Ready cannot fabricate completion. Ignored messages do not synthesize acknowledgements.
Bind/Execute/Describe/Close/Sync and COPY completion can progress while new SQL admission is blocked. COPY remains attached to the initiating cycle.
Native PREPARE and EXECUTE retain complete exact-source grammar acceptance and shared connection-local provenance. Cache decisions cannot establish a target.
implementation_requirements: Mark effects and enqueue Q/Sync barriers before any forwarding write; ensure backend processing cannot observe a response before this state exists.

Retain prior singleton ordered-family and expected leading-keyword classification, token byte-span validation, ASCII native-name folding and namespace limits. As accepted in council, reject protocol statement names above63bytes to prevent mixed-namespace truncation aliases.

Cover P/B/D/E/C/S barrier traces, including Bind then pipelined new Parse without Execute, old Ready after newer effects, fragmented lexical ParameterStatus, unsolicited Ready and ignored-message handling.
Preserve unchanged full pg_dump/pg_restore ACL contents and previous failed evidence; prove real utility compatibility and per-client proxy endpoint/counter coverage.

formal_assessment.conclusion: The unchanged generic forwardEffect/completeCycle model covers the revised policy under explicit adapter mapping assumptions. List-pending lemmas retain newer effects and require validated completion. No additional theorem is necessary solely to expand the set of mapped effect-capable messages.
formal_assessment.required_gate: Run both clean final revision6 formal builds before production implementation; previous revision proof reports are not final-hash closure.
formal_assessment.limits: Cycle mapping, SQL body extraction, normalization and Python/wire correspondence are trusted adapter obligations, not proved refinement. No backend execution success is inferred from accepted provenance.
